summary.zh: 以控制与生存为核心的冰法加点示例。
summary.en: A demo Frost mage allocation built around control and survivability.

pros.zh: 减速与冻结提供很高的容错。
pros.en: Slows and freezes give a large safety margin.

cons.zh: 爆发伤害低于奥术路线。
cons.en: Lower burst than an Arcane path.

note.zh: 先建立伤害与护甲基础。
获得冰锥控制与急速冷却。
note.en: Gain Cone of Cold control and Cold Snap.

note.zh: 碎冰成型后补深度冻结。
note.en: Finish Shatter, then take Deep Freeze.

provenance.source: Demo fixture authored for tooling development
provenance.notes: Demo build; allocation is engine-valid but not real game data.
